architecture.http_process: durable WAL admission, in-memory execution identity probes, and HTTP only
architecture.native_owner: one spawned process owns every MetaTrader5 read and write
architecture.read_transport: generation-fenced duplex Pipe with admission recheck before native reads
architecture.write_transport: ADMITTED -> generation wake -> PENDING -> CLAIMED -> SENDING -> terminal WAL
architecture.wakeup: generation-scoped cross-process Pipe with durable 50ms poll fallback
architecture.post_trade_refresh: coalesced low-priority positions and account snapshot refresh that yields to admitted trades
architecture.public_tick_read: per-symbol request snapshot; cache-only during trade activity and quiet tail

deployment_order: Acquire and retain QH blocking maintenance and prove all QH accounts, jobs, commands, locks, reservations, positions, and bridge queues are idle.
Verify the live MT5 code and build exactly match mt5-tick-isolation-20260817.3 and both hedge_pro accounts match their expected identities.
Run deploy.ps1 with the sealed manifest SHA256 and QHMaintenanceOwned switch.
Verify both ports, the single native owner, the cell watchdog, exact candidate hashes, zero positions, zero queues, and retained QH maintenance.

rollback_policy.code_and_environment: Restore the exact .3 code and pre-deploy environment files while QH maintenance remains held.
rollback_policy.durable_execution_evidence: Never restore or roll back the live idempotency database, WAL, or SHM; preserve broker evidence at its newest state.

physical_limit: The bridge removes avoidable WAL wake and native-read contention. Broker order_send latency and terminal serialization remain external and cannot be guaranteed below 0.5 seconds.
